heading: Privacy & Authorization
subtitle: Review purposes, retention periods, and current consent, or request an export or deletion of your information.
evidenceTitle: Withdrawal does not erase records that must legally be retained
evidenceDescription: Withdrawal stops future processing that relies on that consent. Contract, tax, dispute, audit, or legally held evidence is handled only after its retention basis ends.

withdraw.title: Withdraw consent for future processing?
withdraw.description: New processing that relies on this consent will stop. Evidence that must be retained will not be deleted immediately.

request.exportDescription: The system will verify and prepare information owned by you.
request.deleteDescription: The system first checks contract, tax, dispute, audit, and legal retention duties. It will not bypass them for immediate deletion.
